mnBazz 1.1.0 — Windows x64

VST3:
  Copy the mnBazz.vst3 folder to:
    C:\Program Files\Common Files\VST3\
  (or to your DAW's VST3 path), then rescan plug-ins.

Standalone:
  Run Standalone\mnBazz.exe.

Monophonic bass synthesizer. 42 factory presets.
User presets: Documents\mnBazz\Presets\*.mnbuzz
